pdf_script = '''
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
from docx import Document

# Read the DOCX content
doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Extract all text content
lines = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if text:
        lines.append(text)

# Also extract table content
for table in doc.tables:
    for row in table.rows:
        row_text = " | ".join(cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells if cell.text.strip())
        if row_text:
            lines.append(row_text)

# Create PDF using PyMuPDF
pdf_doc = fitz.open()
page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=595, height=842)  # A4 size

# Write content
y = 50
fontsize_title = 16
fontsize_body = 10
line_height = 14

for line in lines:
    if y > 790:  # New page if needed
        page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=595, height=842)
        y = 50

    # Detect title vs body
    if line == "Customer Activity Report":
        fs = fontsize_title
        font = "helv"
    else:
        fs = fontsize_body
        font = "helv"

    # Handle long lines by wrapping
    max_chars = 90
    while len(line) > max_chars:
        # Find a good break point
        break_at = line.rfind(' ', 0, max_chars)
        if break_at == -1:
            break_at = max_chars
        segment = line[:break_at]
        line = line[break_at:].lstrip()
        page.insert_text((50, y), segment, fontsize=fs, fontname=font)
        y += line_height
        if y > 790:
            page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=595, height=842)
            y = 50

    page.insert_text((50, y), line, fontsize=fs, fontname=font)
    y += line_height + 2

pdf_doc.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf_doc.close()
print("PDF created successfully at /workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
await write_file("./convert_docx_to_pdf.py", pdf_script)
print("Script written")
